newsitem.title: UK: Cowie director resigns ahead of EGM.
newsitem.headline: Cowie director resigns ahead of EGM.

text.p: UK leasing-to-bus company Cowie Group Plc said on Monday that director Neil Pykett had resigned just days ahead of an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) of shareholders specifically called to remove him from the job.
Pykett was a group director and managing director of Cowie Financial Holdings and Cowie said in February that he had been relieved of his executive duties.

Cowie chairman Sir James McKinnon said in a statement that the company had received nearly 85.2 million proxy votes in favour of the removal of Pykett compared to some 6.6 million against his removal by the close of proxy voting.
McKinnon said it was not possible to cancel the meeting, called for April 9, and advised shareholders not to attend.
He added that Cowie would "vigorously contest" any legal claim made against the company by Pykett.
Pykett was removed for alleged gross misconduct and had said he would sue Cowie for unfair dismissal if the shareholders removed him at the EGM.
